title: Remembering Graeme Macann
body:
It is with great sadness that we share the passing of **Graeme Macann** (19 July 1946 – 17 January 2026), who died peacefully on Saturday morning at Ryman Logan Campbell Village after a long battle with melanoma.

Graeme was Principal of Rosehill College from **Term 4, 2003 to Term 3, 2014**. During his time at the College, he led with quiet strength, integrity, and an unwavering commitment to the education and wellbeing of our students. His leadership helped shape the direction of the school and left a lasting impression on the many staff, students, and families who were part of the Rosehill community.

Graeme will be remembered with warmth, respect, and gratitude by all who had the privilege of knowing him and working alongside him. His contribution to Rosehill College remains an important part of our history, and his legacy continues to be reflected in our school community.

Our thoughts are with Graeme's family, friends, and loved ones at this difficult time.
